newsitem.title: UK: LCE nearby sugar contracts end slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: LCE nearby sugar contracts end slightly firmer.

text.p: White sugar futures closed mixed with nearby contracts eeking out modest gains ahead of the October expiry later this week.
Front-month October ended 40 cents firmer at $348.00 per tonne after ranging from $349.30 and $347.80.
Volume was 4,890 lots, with 2,696 concentrated in October.
More switch activity was expected ahead of the October contract's expiry on September 13, traders said.
White sugar futures jumped to a high of $353.00 last week but then drifted to hit a low of $347.30 on Friday.
"It (the market) had a good rally but it will now have trouble getting over resistance," a trader said.
In Paris, October finished 10 cents lower at $349.90 and December closed 80 cents down at $346.20.
